changeSet.author: nclusion
changeSet.comment: Index devices.oldNumber (AlloyDB index advisor). CONCURRENTLY (hence runInTransaction=false) so the build never blocks writes on a live database. The leading DROP also runs on a first deploy, where it replaces any same-named index with this definition; it exists for the retry after an interrupted CONCURRENTLY build, which leaves an INVALID index that IF NOT EXISTS alone would silently keep. A succeeded changeset never re-executes.

changeSet.comment: Index configurationApplications.applicationVersionId (AlloyDB index advisor, 3 query shapes). CONCURRENTLY build behind a leading DROP; see changeset 09.09.26-12:00 for the rationale.
